name: band assisted chin up (from knee)
description: A chin-up with a band under one knee to lighten the load. It builds lats and biceps on the way to full chin-ups.
instructions: Attach a band to a pull-up bar and place one knee in the loop.
Grab the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Hang with your arms straight and your core tight.
Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Switch knees halfway through your sets.
